subject: Outcome Request: Contract comments and pilot timeline for VertexPay
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Wang <oliver@vertexpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Outcome Request: Contract comments and pilot timeline for VertexPay

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Scope: 6-week pilot (payments routing + reconciliation) covering US operations only.
- Success criteria: 99.5% inference uptime, <150ms median latency at 1k RPS, and reconciliation accuracy >99%.
- Deliverables: pilot SOW (attached), sample integration checklist, and test dataset access.
- Legal/procurement: you mentioned legal would send back a mark-up; if possible we'd like to see redlines by EOD Friday so we can slot engineering for a July 12 start.

Attachments: Pilot_SOW_v1.docx (SOW draft)

Next steps:
1) Oliver — please send any contract redlines to me + CC legal.
2) I’ll coordinate a technical onboarding slot with Marcus once we have legal greenlight.
3) If timing shifts, flag priority and we’ll adjust the start date.

Happy to hop on a quick 15-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for teams building with LLMs.
From: Oliver Wang <oliver@vertexpay.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@vertexpay.com, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@vertexpay.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outcome Request: Contract comments and pilot timeline for VertexPay

Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap. Attached are our initial comments; legal added a few edits and questions inline (see attachment). The main asks from counsel are:

- Clarify data retention and deletion processes for logs/KV cache (we need a 12-month retention window, with certified deletion at end of pilot).
- Liability cap language: our counsel prefers a 1x annual spend cap for pilot agreements.
- Audit access: they want an audit clause scoped to security posture only.

I’ve looped in our internal counsel (legal@vertexpay.com and Samantha) to drive this. We’ll try to consolidate comments and get something back by Monday but can’t promise the July 12 start until counsel signs off.

Attachment: VertexPay_Contract_Redlines_20260702.pdf (pdf, 28KB)

Thanks,
Oliver Wang
Head of Product | VertexPay
oliver@vertexpay.com
